workloads.description: Unchanged full1024 fixed31; finiteness, all-pixel RGBmax1, sampled float max0.002; preserve noise/truncation fixtures
Actual seed/text/Unicode to latent to full1024 output with mapping hash and identity regression; fixed W+ alone does not execute mapping
First validated face and at least3 warm repeats, separate initialization/readback, fixed full1024 output
26 useful frames, total generation/preview/export time, bounded frame queue; no style-prefix reuse claim for ordinary morph
Classic linear, pairwise ellipse/figure8, full-smooth ellipse/figure8; N2/3/5 and declared maximum, endpoints/midpoints/seam and actual rendered outputs
Two fixed synthetic aligned and unaligned photos, no-face and malformed input; actual decode/alignment/e4e and W+ reference tolerance0.0001
Alignment→actual encoder→full1024 synthesis→original cache, repeat photo, paired-photo morph/video; record actual encoder and synthesis providers separately
Empty local model cache versus retained assets; actual transfer provenance, interruption/resume, cross-version reuse, quota/denial; image cache hit performs zero inference/model initialization
Declared repeated-job workload/duration, memory growth/peak, tab watchdog, worker/context loss, cancellation, background/foreground and bounded CPU retry
Control plus concrete larger-residency/tile/queue candidates;384MiB is not a ceiling. Account extra bytes, measure paired latency/throughput and complete-pipeline reliability

metrics.stageFormat: status=measured/not-measured/not-applicable; samplesMs only for measured stages, scope and overlap explicit. Unknown is null, never0.
timingRules: Record clock/synchronisation and whether host readback is included
Measure cold download separately from process-first initialization; identify cache provenance
At least3 repeats and reversed control/candidate ordering on same physical device for promotion
Simulator cannot establish physical-phone speed or memory survival
S24 Ultra comparison is a cross-device target; optimisation gains require same-device control
metrics.missingMetrics: Explicitly unmeasured; legacy reports retain their original scope and cannot be retroactively v2 complete

qualification.synthesis: Fixed research31 separate from nativeCI31; require exact fixture identities
qualification.e4e: Actual encoder executed plus per-photo W+ checks; synthesis of encoded-photo fixture does not count
qualification.precision: FP32 mainline; FP16/quantization separate experimental policy, no inherited quality pass
qualification.runtime: Requested provider differs from demonstrated executed provider; record fallbacks
qualification.release: Use release-tests catalogue for integrated release gates; benchmark plan/results alone do not qualify a release

handoff.ownerSplit: Research owns versioned candidate runners/manifests; operator owns separate packaging/site deployment
immutableBundle: supported adapter inputs/outputs and cancellation behavior
handoff.promotion: Explicitly select and pin immutable bundle in candidate site; never import mutable research directories or silently swap models
handoff.trial: Separate site deployment is not automatically the28-day public comparison start

matrixScope: Research scheduling matrix, not an exhaustive support declaration. Preserve release-tests target catalogue and explicitly register additional runtime/architecture combinations.
